TWO_BLOCKS_TOGETHER_NOT_ADJACENT.rule: Both specified disjoint groups form consecutive blocks, and the two formed block-units are not adjacent.

BLOCK_WITH_OUTSIDER_NOT_ADJACENT.rule: The specified group forms a consecutive block, and a named outsider is not immediately before or after that block.

ONE_BLOCK_TOGETHER_OTHER_NOT_TOGETHER.rule: The first specified group forms a block, while the second disjoint group must not form one complete consecutive block.

NOT_ALL_BLOCKS_TOGETHER.rule: At least one specified group is broken; exclude only arrangements in which every specified group forms its block simultaneously.
